report.summary: Firmware flashes and boots through driver init, but aborts with "Instruction address misaligned" inside esp-dsp (dsps_dotprod_f32_arp4) during wake-word feature extraction right after the voice command vocabulary registers — the emulator dies before the REPL/app_logic init, so no feature can be exercised.

tests.name: Flash and boot to app_main
tests.details: Flash succeeded, image loaded from ota_0, board manager + drivers initialised (I2S, ES8389 codec, WS2812 strip on GPIO37, GT1151 touch, RGB LCD, ADC button group, boot button on GPIO61). SD-card mount fails (no card in the emulator) and the camera SCCB probe logs an error, but the OV3660 is then detected — no wrong behaviour attributable to the product.
tests.evidence: I (664) BOARD_MANAGER: Board manager initialized / I (664) app_driver: Hardware drivers initialized / I (664) heating: no saved room table — using the defaults

tests.name: Voice model / vocabulary init
tests.details: Wake word wn9_hiesp and mn7_en MultiNet loaded from the 'model' partition; heating_voice registers all 21 phrases covering the four rooms plus kitchen/bedroom refusal phrases, 'plus one' and 'cancel'.
tests.evidence: I (664) MODEL_LOADER: Successfully load srmodels / I (1004) heating_voice: 21 of 21 phrases registered / 21 active speech commands (1600-1620)

tests.name: Stable boot — no crash / panic
tests.details: Immediately after the speech commands are built, hart1 faults with an illegal instruction / 'Instruction address misaligned' and the firmware aborts. The emulator process exits (exit code 1); the serial log ends there. Nothing after app_audio_init runs: no app_display_init/heating_ui_init ('dashboard up (4 rooms)' never appears), no heating_web_install/app_webui_init, no app_mqtt_init, no diagnostics_clock_init, no app_logic_init ('heating panel logic up' never appears), no app_console_init, and no 'ZeroCode AI firmware started'. This is a boot-blocking crash that stops the REPL from ever coming up, so the whole functional checklist is unreachable.
tests.evidence: [WARN machine::rom_stubs] panic_info: reason='Instruction address misaligned' desc='Exception was unhandled.' info.addr=0x4012AF74 | Firmware abort: Instruction address misaligned / Backtrace: #0 0x4012af74 in dsps_dotprod_f32_arp4 () at managed_components/espressif__esp-dsp/modules/dotprod/float/dsps_dotprod_f32_arp4.S:52, #11 esp_mel_dotprod_f32 () at components/c_speech_features/esp_speech_features/esp_speech_features.c:209, #29 esp_mel_dotprod_step () / [host] emulator stopped: esp-emu exited on its own (exit code 1)

tests.name: Console REPL (help, uptime, chip, version, heap)
tests.details: Never reached — app_console_init runs after the failing audio init, and the emulator aborted before the REPL appeared. No command could be sent.

tests.name: heating set <room 0-3> <degC> and 'already set' 30 s guard (f17)
tests.details: requires the console (app_logic_init) which never came up; also needs a broker peer to observe the published payload.

tests.name: MQTT publish {"current_heating_setpoint":"x.y"} to TRV state topic (f4/f16), permit_join {"time":254} (f10)
tests.details: No network peers in the emulator and MQTT never started before the abort; no evidence either way.

tests.name: TRV state parsing, system_mode heating/off, air-sensor override (f15/f18/f7)
tests.details: Needs synthetic zigbee2mqtt payloads from a broker; unreachable here.

tests.name: Dashboard 2x2 room grid, selection, +/- 0.5 °C, overlays (f2/f3/f8/f19/f13/f17)
tests.details: Touch input, display rendering and the on-screen banners cannot be observed on this device, and heating_ui_init never ran anyway.

tests.name: Status LED colours (dim white/green/amber/red flash) (f6/f12)
tests.details: LED strip driver binds successfully (1 LED, GPIO37) but colour is a physical observation not available from the serial log/emulator.

tests.name: Push-to-talk front button / BOOT button / wake word listening window (f1/f11/f9)
tests.details: Requires a physical button press or real microphone audio. Also blocked: the audio pipeline aborts on the first wake-word feature extraction.

tests.name: SoftAP + mDNS onboarding and settings web page (/settings, /api/state, /api/set) (f5)
tests.details: app_webui_init never ran (crash before it). Onboarding also needs a controller/browser, which is deferred to the testing expert on real hardware.

tests.name: Factory reset 10 s hold, NVS-persisted targets surviving reboot (f13, power blip)
tests.details: Button hold is physical; persistence could not be observed because the firmware dies at the same point on every boot before any NVS read of targets beyond the room table load.

deviceInfo.emulator: ESP32 series emulator v0.50.0, user-mode network backend
deviceInfo.crashPoint: dsps_dotprod_f32_arp4 (esp-dsp) via esp_mel_dotprod_f32 / esp_mel_dotprod_step during audio front-end feature extraction
deviceInfo.connectivity: never established — abort occurred before app_mqtt_init

notes: The crash is in esp-dsp's hand-written RISC-V assembly (dsps_dotprod_f32_arp4.S) reached from c_speech_features, i.e. inside the audio framework's modelling/wake-word pipeline, not in product code. It may be an emulator gap for esp32s31 vector/DSP instructions, but from the log alone the device visibly aborts, which by the rules is a failure.

Earlier non-fatal lines seen and NOT counted as failures on their own: sdmmc_init_ocr send_op_cond 0x107 (no SD card present), sccb_i2c transmit failures then 'ov3660: Detected Camera sensor PID=0x3660', 'W i2s_common: GPIO 5/4 is not usable', 'W gpio: conflict found for GPIO[7]'.
No feature of the spec could be exercised: the console REPL was never reached, so no functional requirement was confirmed or refuted on this device.
report.suggestedFix: Make the second boot get past the audio front-end: the fault is an illegal/misaligned instruction in esp-dsp's dsps_dotprod_f32_arp4 called from esp_mel_dotprod_step. Select an esp-dsp implementation path that does not use the ARP4/PIE vector assembly for this target (e.g. force the generic C/ANSI dot-product variant via the esp-dsp Kconfig/source selection) or disable the hardware PIE acceleration for esp32s31, and only then register the voice vocabulary, so that app_audio_init completes and the rest of the boot (display, web, MQTT, app_logic console) can be reached and tested.
